command:
cat > /etc/init.d/data-lvm <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/sbin/openrc-run

description="Attach the persistent LVM loop PV and mount /srv/data"

backing_file="/var/lib/lvm-loop/data-pv.img"
mount_point="/srv/data"
volume="/dev/vgdata/lvdata"

depend() {
    need localmount
    after bootmisc
}

start() {
    ebegin "Activating persistent data logical volume"
    loopdev=$(losetup -j "$backing_file" | sed -n '1s/:.*//p')
    if [ -z "$loopdev" ]; then
        loopdev=$(losetup --find --show "$backing_file") || { eend 1; return 1; }
    fi
    pvscan --cache "$loopdev" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { eend 1; return 1; }
    vgchange -ay vgdata >/dev/null 2>&1 || { eend 1; return 1; }
    mkdir -p "$mount_point"
    if ! mountpoint -q "$mount_point"; then
        mount "$volume" "$mount_point" || { eend 1; return 1; }
    fi
    eend 0
}

stop() {
    ebegin "Deactivating persistent data logical volume"
    mountpoint -q "$mount_point" && umount "$mount_point"
    vgchange -an vgdata >/dev/null 2>&1
    loopdev=$(losetup -j "$backing_file" | sed -n '1s/:.*//p')
    [ -n "$loopdev" ] && losetup -d "$loopdev"
    eend 0
}
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0755 /etc/init.d/data-lvm
rc-update add data-lvm default
rc-update show default | grep -E '(^|[[:space:]])data-lvm([[:space:]]|$)'
/etc/init.d/data-lvm status
